---
title: "Publications" 
listing: 
  contents: 
    - "**/index.qmd"
    - "**/index.markdown"
    - "**/index.md"
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  categories: false
  sort-ui: true
  filter-ui: true
  fields: [title, author, categories, date]
  image-align: left
  # image-height: 10em
  # page-size: 5

format: 
  html: 
    page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false

header-includes: >
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../assets/listing-default.css">
resources:
  - ../assets/listing-default.css
---

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var input = document.querySelector('.quarto-listing-filter input.search');
  var listing = document.querySelector('.list.quarto-listing-default');
  if (!input || !listing) return;

  var activeCategory = '';

  // Intercept quartoListingCategory before anything else captures it.
  // It bypasses the text input entirely and calls list.filter() directly,
  // so we must track the active category ourselves.
  var origFn = window.quartoListingCategory;
  window.quartoListingCategory = function (cat) {
    try { activeCategory = decodeURIComponent(atob(cat)); } catch (e) { activeCategory = ''; }
    if (origFn) origFn(cat);
    syncChips();
    syncBadge();
  };

  // ── Category chip bar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var excluded = new Set(['research']); // on ~90% of papers, not useful as a filter
  var allCats = new Set();
  document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-post[data-categories]').forEach(function (item) {
    var enc = item.getAttribute('data-categories');
    if (!enc) return;
    try {
      decodeURIComponent(atob(enc)).split(',').forEach(function (c) {
        var t = c.trim();
        if (t && !excluded.has(t)) allCats.add(t);
      });
    } catch (e) {}
  });

  var chipBar = document.createElement('div');
  chipBar.id = 'pub-chip-bar';

  function makeChip(label, cat) {
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className = 'pub-cat-chip';
    btn.textContent = label;
    btn.dataset.cat = cat;
    return btn;
  }

  var allChip = makeChip('All', '');
  allChip.classList.add('active');
  allChip.addEventListener('click', resetFilter);
  chipBar.appendChild(allChip);

  Array.from(allCats).sort().forEach(function (cat) {
    var chip = makeChip(cat, cat);
    chip.addEventListener('click', function () {
      input.value = '';
      window.quartoListingCategory(btoa(encodeURIComponent(cat)));
    });
    chipBar.appendChild(chip);
  });

  listing.parentNode.insertBefore(chipBar, listing);

  function syncChips() {
    chipBar.querySelectorAll('.pub-cat-chip').forEach(function (el) {
      el.classList.toggle('active', el.dataset.cat === activeCategory);
    });
  }

  // ── Text-search filter badge ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  var bar = document.createElement('div');
  bar.id = 'pub-filter-bar';
  bar.innerHTML =
    '<span>Filtered by: <strong id="pub-filter-label"></strong></span>' +
    '<button id="pub-filter-clear">&#x2715; Show all</button>';
  listing.parentNode.insertBefore(bar, listing);

  function syncBadge() {
    var val = input.value.trim();
    bar.style.display = val ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('pub-filter-label').textContent = val;
  }

  input.addEventListener('input', function () {
    activeCategory = '';
    syncChips();
    syncBadge();
  });

  document.getElementById('pub-filter-clear').addEventListener('click', resetFilter);

  function resetFilter() {
    activeCategory = '';
    input.value = '';
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    if (origFn) origFn('');
    syncChips();
    syncBadge();
  }
});
</script>
```
